title: DISTINCTCOUNT counts a stored BLANK as a value

source.quote: DISTINCTCOUNT function counts the BLANK value
DISTINCTCOUNT considers BLANK as a valid value, whereas
source.supports: BLANK is a valid value for DISTINCTCOUNT

derivation: Product[Color] stores Red, Blue and BLANK (Bell): 3 distinct values, the BLANK included. The blank row's BLANK is the same value, so the answer is 3 whether or not the blank row counts.
